skills.name: adversarial-verification
skills.description: Use when claims or evidence need adversarial validation by 3-5 independent agents. Requires unanimous convergence. Triggers: patents, papers, grants, investor relations, legal docs, numeric claims, novelty, prior-art, and fact-checking.

skills.name: agent-security-scan
skills.description: Use for report-only static scans of settings, hooks, skills, Model Context Protocol config, credential surfaces, remote fetches, shell side effects, and broad exposure risks.

skills.name: boundary-contract
skills.description: Declares the objective, allowed and prohibited surfaces, criteria, phase and stop conditions of work for which task-router requires a boundary contract.

skills.name: brainstorming
skills.description: Resolves design decisions and expected behavior still unsettled before implementation. Not for decisions already settled.

skills.name: compact-handoff
skills.description: Records the objective, boundary, evidence and next action in a handoff when long context, an agent transfer or compaction could lose them, before the transfer or the compaction request.

skills.name: dispatching-parallel-agents
skills.description: Use when two or more independent tasks can be handled in parallel. Each task must be able to proceed without shared state or sequential dependency.

skills.name: executing-plans
skills.description: Executes an accepted plan inline in the authorized checkout when inline execution is chosen.

skills.name: finishing-a-development-branch
skills.description: Use when implementation is ready for integration, when the user asks to merge or publish a pull request, or when the branch finishing path remains undecided.

skills.name: merge-companion
skills.description: Reviews the user changes that a skill installer backed up, before the selected work modifies, replaces or installs an installed skill and when the user asks for that review. Not for an unrelated read-only lookup.

skills.name: necessity-gate
skills.description: Task-justification gate for new tasks, skills, files, audit cycles, or follow-ups. Compares problem evidence, regression risk, and recovery benefit; decides approve, reject, or modify. Blocks speculative work.

skills.name: receiving-code-review
skills.description: Use when receiving code review feedback before implementing suggestions, especially when feedback is ambiguous or technically questionable. Enforces technical rigor and verification instead of performative agreement or blind implementation.

skills.name: requesting-code-review
skills.description: Use after completing major functionality, before merging, or when a pull request has new commits, automated findings, or unresolved review threads.

skills.name: session-intent-analyzer
skills.description: Writes a new or changed interpreted-as record before the first tool call of work, and reads stored intent when it can change work selection.

skills.name: skill-evolution
skills.description: Recommends skill changes from repeated tool/workflow patterns and supported conduct corrections when the user asks about skill upgrades, update recommendations or an evolution backlog.

skills.name: subagent-driven-development
skills.description: Executes an accepted plan of independent tasks in the current session, with a fresh implementer for each task.

skills.name: systematic-debugging
skills.description: For a failure whose cause and sufficient correction depth need investigation, tests causal hypotheses, corrects the supported cause and counts failed repair rounds.

skills.name: task-router
skills.description: Selects the work, skills, criteria and boundary for a request that needs or may need a tool, other than a light-path lookup. Not for a direct answer.

skills.name: test-driven-development
skills.description: Writes a failing test first for a feature or bug fix whose expected behavior is known and automatically testable. Not for configuration, generated-output or instruction changes without a meaningful behavioral test.

skills.name: using-coding-convention
skills.description: Selects the coding-convention family skill for development work before its first read, command, edit, plan or review. A direct answer or a confirmation question ends before this workflow.

skills.name: using-git-worktrees
skills.description: Selects or creates an isolated checkout, only when the authorized development task requires isolation.

skills.name: verification-before-completion
skills.description: Checks a new completion, fix, success, verified-status or material recommendation claim against its criterion and evidence before it is made, and decides whether an artifact must be reread to support a claim.

skills.name: writing-plans
skills.description: Use when requirements for a multi-step task are known and before touching code. Documents everything as bite-sized tasks for an engineer with zero codebase context. Use for implementation plans, task decomposition, and planning before TDD.

skills.name: writing-skills
skills.description: Writes, changes or verifies a skill package and validates the decision it affects.
